confidence_rubric: A=DFT converged multi-witness/validated; B=single-config DFT/MLIP or relative; C=fast proxy

system.provenance: cascade_v23 rank-1 dopant (Sc2O3); NOT yet deep-validated

screening.caveats: fast screening estimate; deep-validation sections are high-fidelity. rank/score from champions.csv (NOTE: ranked.csv lists B2O3 #6/47 by a different stability metric). cascade evolves -> re-link by (version, candidate_id).

transport.method: UMA-s-1p1 MLIP-MD, MSD window 2-50 ps, 3pt Arrhenius, Nernst-Einstein (Haven=1)
transport.caveats: MLIP NE overestimates absolute sigma ~3-5x; Ea+relative-vs-modelc robust (same Ea as modelc, ~1.33x higher sigma, D0-driven). Ea uncertainty ~+-0.01 eV (MSD-window sensitivity). BVSE barrier is in softBV val^2 units (relative, resolution-limited), NOT eV -> needs NEB calibration.

thermodynamic_stability.caveats: metastable (+37.5 meV/atom) but phonon-stable real phase; decomp includes Li3BS3 (BS3 thioborate) + Li4B7ClO12 -> independently corroborates the BS3/borate motif.

electrochemical_window.method: grand-potential ESW (MP GGA/GGA+U hull) + MP band gaps of SEI products

passivation_thresholds_eV.note: heuristic rule-of-thumb, not a hard physical boundary

electrochemical_window.caveats: window is NARROW (0.31 V) = a real risk, NOT solved. SEI has wide-gap members (B2O3 8.4, BPO4 7.0, Li3PO4 5.7) AND leaky members in the SAME predicted decomposition (Li3BS3 3.05, Li2B2S5 2.44, Li3P 0.7). Passivation is plausible ONLY IF the interphase is dense/continuous and the leaky thioborates are minor -- interphase morphology/electron-tunneling NOT modeled here.

mechanical.method: DFT relaxed-ion finite-strain Cij (running on KISTI); EOS B0 as proxy
mechanical.caveats: elastic relaxed-ion 12-strain chain running; cascade fast-estimate E~41-43 GPa (screening). EOS B0 24.5 GPa (+13% vs undoped, DFT).

electronic.method: DFT DOS/PDOS (scf->nscf->projwfc); scalars curated (no machine-readable summary)
electronic.caveats: GGA underestimates gaps; single config/functional -> grade B not A. gap 1.97 eV (VBM 2.47/CBM 4.44).

structure_chemistry.method: coordination (Voronoi) + bond lengths + Bader oxidation states (parsed) + Lowdin S-site order
structure_chemistry.caveats: BS3 confirmed 5 independent ways (coord/hull/DOS/ESW/charge) = multi-witness -> grade A. USPP Bader net charges are relative (B basin collapses; S-site order from Lowdin).

dynamical_stability.verdict: DYNAMICALLY STABLE (0 imaginary; soft Li band ~14 cm-1)
dynamical_stability.caveats: Gamma-only (UMA) -> qualitative stability only; quantitative Raman/IR needs DFPT.

xps: S 2p: free-S2-(low BE) < PS4-S < B-S/BS3(high BE shoulder)
raman_ir: P-O phosphate stretch ~900-1013 cm-1 (absent in undoped)
testable_predictions.caveats: positions/order computable; absolute XPS eV needs dSCF core-hole; Nd 3d is literature-only (multiplet).

anode_interface_stability.caveats: Li-metal reduction at the ESW lower limit; headline risk (red 1.72 V near Li).

critical_current_density.caveats: dendrite resistance / CCD — most-requested SE metric; not computed.

grain_boundary_transport.caveats: bulk sigma != total sigma; GB often dominates.

electronic_conductivity.caveats: sigma_electronic (self-discharge driver), beyond just band gap.
